spanish: Estos los impuros a ustedes en todo el reptil; todo el tocante en ellos en su morir se impurecerá hasta la tarde.

findings.issue: H8318 names the swarming/creeping creature as a class; «reptil» narrows it to the reptile taxon.
H4194 is the noun death with a 3mp suffix; «morir» is a verbal infinitive. The sense of their death remains.
H6153 is evening; «tarde» can be read as afternoon.

notes: Verbless clause has no added copula; 2mp לכם as ustedes is licensed.
